notes: Third sweep (2026-10-22-b): five runs (opus-1, haiku-1, haiku-2, sonnet-1, sonnet-2) at head 0397dec with no uncommitted changes (skill_hash 48939e64...); every run has rc 0 and a model_id matching its tier.

None of the six listed rules changed since db91c23: git diff db91c23 -- idiomatic-elixir/ touches only SKILL.md (the one-step `with` paragraph, the new rule Use `do:` for a one-expression body and `do ... end` for anything else, and the captures sentence) and references/testing.md (Assert with patterns). ecto-phoenix.md is unchanged, so all six are graded to the previous sweep's standard, including its reading of Validate input with changesets: a struct of code-set values passed to Repo.insert (skill-sonnet-1 line 147: Repo.insert(%Log{) is not the params-built struct the rule names.

Changed rules outside the list were checked for other_violations and none is broken: every `with` has two `<-` steps; no run uses a capture; the only `do:` bodies are one-expression clauses (opus-1 line 84: def get_post!(id), do: Repo.get!(Post, id); sonnet-1 line 136: def publish_post(%Post{}), do: {:error, :already_published}, a short pattern-matching clause beside a block clause, which the new rule allows). One-expression bodies kept in blocks (publish_changeset/2, the controllers' show/2) are not accessors, predicates or short pattern-matching clauses, so the sentence "Use `do:` for a body of one expression that reads as part of the head" does not require do: for them.

Keep migrations to schema changes: 2 of 5 violated, both Haiku (haiku-1 line 123, haiku-2 line 108), up from 1 of 5 in the previous sweep. Both backfill with raw SQL rather than the schema module, and haiku-1 says it chose to: line 121: # migration. Backfilling here is what was asked for; the skill's advice to; line 122: # move data changes to a script is the alternative if this must run separately. The other three write a separate script on the "posts" table.

Validate input with changesets: 0 of 5 violated, down from 1 of 5; four runs use assoc_constraint(:user) and sonnet-1 uses foreign_key_constraint(:user_id) (line 62). Every run casts only [:title, :body] and sets user_id on the struct.

format_ok: result.json reports false for all five because plain mix format adds parentheses to Ecto and Phoenix DSL calls. As in the previous sweeps, the grader recomputed it with Code.format_string!/2 and the DSL calls (field, belongs_to, timestamps, from, add, alter, execute, remove and others) in locals_without_parens: four pass; sonnet-1 fails on line 25, a from/2 call over 98 characters that the formatter splits. Nothing compiles because Phoenix and Ecto are not installed.

other_violations follow the previous standard: a missing @moduledoc on the context or a public context function without @doc counts (haiku-2 line 58: def get_post!(id) do); missing @moduledoc or @doc on schema modules and their changeset functions does not (haiku-2 and sonnet-2 put a why-comment above Post.changeset/2, lines 16 and 44). No run pipes a single step this sweep, and no MyApp.Blog lacks @moduledoc.

Transcripts show every run reading exactly SKILL.md and references/ecto-phoenix.md and writing blog.ex in one Write call; opus-1 then made one Edit to the backfill script, naming the query before Repo.update_all/2. No run ran elixir or mix.
